notes.title: Update V05 - The End
notes.content:
Welcome to update V05! The last update

[h3]Powerups are now available![/h3]
Powerups are collected by killing an enemy and picking up the coin that has been dropped.
[list]
[*] Quick Thinking - Reduces your reload time so you can shoot faster
[*] Double Time - Increases the risk of broken legs and lets you run faster
[*] Shields+ and Ammo+ for everyone!
[/list]
[h3]Laser improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]The laser is now blazing fast and has pinpoint accuracy
[*]The players now have hitboxes and whatever you've hit is now shown in the killfeed
[*]Hit detection is now frame independent and is now multithreaded
[/list]
[h3]Audio changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]The footsteps are now louder
[*]New sound effects for jumping, landing and dashing
[*]All sounds are now dynamically spawned for more immersiveness
[*]Music is now available
[/list]
[h3]Ingame UI changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]The ingame UI has been added and is now displaying your shields, shots, your augmentation (pickup) and if your dash is currently available
[*]New crosshairs
[*]Some improvements to the match display and scoreboard
[/list]
[h3]Map changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]FFA has been renamed to Cargo
[*]Train is now available as a playable map
[*]FFA3 has been reworked again with light fixes and area changes
[*]The map Dusk is now available in 2 variants. Dusk with Houses and Dusk with Rocks
[*]The 1v1 map Sanctuary is now playable again
[/list]
[h3]Server side Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]The server now allows for selecting teams
[*]You can now vote for the next map after the match has ended
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Exiting a wall run now restores the dash
[*]Shot server delay is now practically 0ms
[*]Open mic bug is now fixed
[/list]

[h3]Is this really the end?[/h3]
Yes absolutely. The last update for this game. If you're curious how it will progress in the future, hop on to our [url=https://discord.gg/KXkggbBGxM]discord[/url] to be one of the first when the game relaunches! 

cheers!

notes.title: Update V04A
notes.content:
[h2]Changes for Update V04A[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where fog & shadows would have abrupt transitions to a lower resolution resulting in what seemed like a circle on screen
[*] Various bug fixes to FFA3 thanks to your feedback!
[*] FFA2 now shares the same texture set as FFA

[/list]

notes.title: It's time for an update
notes.content:
A pretty rushed update but we are back.
The goal with this update was to make the game playable again. So if you encounter any errors, please report them on the steam forums or on our [url=https://discord.gg/xYJ6JT93sM]discord server[/url]!

[b]What changed?[/b]


[h3]Unity3D Engine[/h3]
The whole project was upgraded from an early 2021.LTS version to the latest and greatest 2023.LTS version. This brings a much needed performance and technical upgrade!

[h3] Community Servers [/h3]
Community Servers are back online with the previously released Free For All maps! Jump straight in to the action without any need to wait.

[h3] Projectile fix [/h3]
Sometimes enemies weren't hit by the lazer. Especially noticeable on close distance. We've changed the hit registration from a trigger system to a more reliable approach - shooting lazers in a quadrant formation out of the lazer! (Raycasting)

[h3] Options Menu[/h3]
Some users have reported resetting of previously set graphics options and others about changing your sliders while the menu was closed. Both of these bugs should be fixed with this update. 

[h3]Other Stuff[/h3]
Unfortunately we've had to remove the statistics with this update but we plan to add them in a future update again.
[b]Furthermore the UI has changed a bit:[/b]
A general rushed overhaul of the main menu, the options and a new ingame crosshair. Also there is a new sound for shooting and you can enjoy all the DLC skins for free for a while!

[h3]What's next?[/h3]
A nice clean up of the whole project. Some things, such as the voice chat, broke for unknown reasons and need to be fixed. Slowly integrating more maps in to the community servers and re-enabling the matchmaking queue for 1v1 action. A readjustment of UI elements and bug fixing.

That's all!

notes.title: The wait is finally over 💀
notes.content:
[h2]Summary[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Matchmaking prototype is now available in Europe, North America, South Asia &[strike] Oceania![/strike]
[*] New (Upgraded) maps for versus
[*] Statistics are now global
[*] UI "Enhancements"
[*] Radio Music is now available
[*] Removed Social
[/olist]
For detailed explanation continue reading below.


[h3]The Matchmaking[/h3]
Matchmaking prototype is now available in West Europe (Berlin), East North America (Montreal), South Asia (Singapore) & [strike]Oceania (Sydney)[/strike]. 

Currently available for Versus are 3 different maps from the very early stages of development that have been upgraded with new assets. Simple yet promising for very short and intense matches. Free For All has 2 maps available and a time limit of 15 minutes. For a win you need to contribute to your team (Red or Blue).

We have replaced the current netcode with a different one. The connection should now be more reliable.

Parties are invite only and you need to have the person you want to play with as a steam friend.

We will be adding more regions and gamemodes as development continues and [b]players are interested[/b] in playing the game.


[h3]The Statistics[/h3]
The statistics are global; meaning from whereever you play, the statistics will count against everyone. For each new game mode, a new category for statistics will be added. The statistics will be refined in the future, so expect us to add seasons to the game very Soon™. 

The statistics have been reset.


[h3]The Visuals[/h3]
Some maps have been upgraded with new game assets. The new maps: BOOMBOX, SANCTUARY and MIRROR are available in Versus. If you find any visual bugs please let us know. Free For All maps will be upgraded in a future update when the new assets are ready.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42784291/a6d9423dda78ac2850226581fca1191f47b692c7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42784291/2676095c2bf6a8be64a95449a264c463a3eca7bf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42784291/7e36af4ca7ea3fcde57d9bf3826b7429d5da8a18.png[/img]



[h3]The UI/UX[/h3]
Some upgrades on the UI have been performed. The Scoreboard now doesn't look like the ugliest scoreboard worldwide anymore, The main menu has been reworked and everything else pretty much. The text chat has been removed from the game completely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42784291/49e23351108f54bcea08832815d8d06b3f25946c.png[/img]


[h3]The Radio[/h3]
Currently there are 3 Stations available for your hearing pleasure. Hard & Heavy (Metal, Rock), Party Hard (Mostly House) and Traphop (90's, Hip Hop, Trap). Proudly given to us by GEMA. If you don't like the music, feel free to turn it off. To turn off the radio, navigate to the Options menu.


[h3]New DLC's[/h3]
We have upgraded and added new skins to the store! Make sure to check them out!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2151870/LAZ3RZ__Supporter_Package/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42784291/83556c19abd91fadd983694686488b52f8767802.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2240180/LAZ3RZ__PRIDE/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42784291/3d051f4f33cfd9fa4dccd35d8c0bf32b7bb740f3.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2240181/LAZ3RZ__CORRUPTION/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42784291/3259d90b302ba41f651f35a9c3783f783b794690.png[/img][/url]


[h3]What's next?[/h3]
Depending on player interest, [b]a lot[/b]. Pretty much everything is still subjecto to change.
New maps, new assets, new gamemodes, free items, paid DLC's. (Buy them [url=https://store.steampowered.com/dlc/2107280/LAZ3RZ/][b]NOW[/b][/url]),[i] la la la[/i]
We expect you to leave feedback, good or bad. Bug reports if you find any.
Please use the steam forums for that.

Also it is now possible to deselect the skins. lul

That's all.

notes.title: Playtest scheduled for 19.08 - 6 PM CET
notes.content:
We will start our first playtest on the 19.08.2022 around 6 PM [b]CET[/b] - Save the date and shoot some laser projectiles at lightspeed with us! [i]pew pew~ [/i]

We currently have 2 regions for Servers available: [b]EU & NA[/b]

[b]Notice:[/b] You will play an [b]early[/b] alpha build, Some features might not work perfectly.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42784291/b8026c99cd0e1cca459bee1672caaf90d005c761.png[/img]

[h2][u]Features[/u][/h2]

Select [b]one of the 9 available characters[/b] and come hang out on our social experience servers! 
We have text & "voice chat" available if you want.
Or you can straight up head in to the arena's! 
Can we wake your curiosity for some Team Death Match or Free For All? Jump Straight in! 
Need the thrill for competetive? Join the precursor matchmaking! 

But most importantly: Can you find [i]the secret area[/i] and all the eastereggs?


[h2][u]Gamemodes[/u][/h2]

[b]1 vs 1 Matchmaking[/b] - Roundbased action on 3 different maps.
[b]2 vs 2 Matchmaking[/b] - Killbased thrill on 2 different maps.
[b]Free For All[/b] on 2 different maps.
[b]Random Team Deathmatch[/b] on 2 different maps.
